name: FrontDeskArrivalsConsole
tagline: Arrivals, room rack, check-in and check-out in one plug-and-play Power Platform app.
description: A complete hotel front desk module: arrivals, departures and in-house lists, a room rack with rule-checked room assignment and upgrades, a tape-chart room plan, a status board, check-in with an ID / registration card / guarantee checklist and early check-in fees, check-out with folio settlement and late check-out fees, no-shows and live front office KPIs. Works instantly with demo data and connects to any canvas data source, a model-driven view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Ranked room suggestions (type, cleanliness, requests, features)
No downgrades, confirmed upgrades, double-booking detection
Early check-in / late check-out approvals with waivable fees
Check-out with balance settlement and payment method
Click or drag guests onto rooms in the rack
Room status changes (inspected, clean, dirty, out of order)
Bulk auto-assign, agent assignment, export, cancel, delete with undo
Occupancy, arrivals, departures, rooms ready and revenue outputs
